name: Long-Term Residence Status

requirements.blocker_text: Requires 5 years of continuous legal residence in Malta.
requirements.fix_path: Accrue 5 years of continuous legal residence.

requirements.blocker_text: Must demonstrate stable and regular financial resources sufficient to maintain oneself without recourse to Malta's social assistance system (exact income threshold not published at tier-1 in this pass).
Must possess own accommodation in Malta.
Must fulfil integration measures under Subsidiary Legislation 217.05 (specific provisions not detailed on the tier-1 page reviewed in this pass).

evidence_required.document: Proof of 5 years of continuous legal residence

outcome.duration_length: status is permanent; residence card issued for 5-year renewable periods

sources.title: Identità -- Expatriates Unit: Long-Term Residence, 5-year continuous residence requirement, stable resources, own accommodation, SL 217.05 integration measures, EUR500 fee

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Malta's initial build. Confirmed directly at tier-1. Income threshold and the specific SL 217.05 integration-measure content were not detailed on the page reviewed. prerequisites.required_prior_route_ids lists plausible qualifying residence permits; the tier-1 page did not specify which permit categories count toward the 5-year clock (e.g. whether nomad or start-up residence time qualifies), so this list is a reasonable but unconfirmed inference. citizenship_after_months left null: this status counts toward mt_naturalisation's residence requirement but the source did not state a combined total distinct from the naturalisation route's own thresholds.
